name: Temari Nara
source:
Temari Nara is a former kunoichi of Sunagakure's Kazekage clan. Temari has teal eyes and sandy blonde hair, which is gathered into four consecutive pigtails. After marrying Shikamaru Nara, she becomes a member of the Nara clan and emigrates to Konoha, where she works as a kunoichi for the village. She would later give birth to their son, Shikadai. Temari is a prudent, stoic and blunt individual who is rarely afraid to speak her mind, a trait she would later pass on to her son.
